_meta.sourcedFrom: Synthetic catalog modeled after sleepcountry.ca product mix and Canadian sleep-retail price points (2026-05-06). Real product images sourced from Unsplash to avoid IP issues.

persona_coverage.researcher_strong: Mattresses are high-stakes purchases — heavy comparison, spec depth, firmness/coil/material differentiation
persona_coverage.hunter_strong: Sale-priced mattresses + boxed brands cover the sale-watcher
persona_coverage.gatherer_strong: Bedding ensembles, sheets, throws cover the bedroom-refresh shopper
persona_coverage.gifter_present: Pillows, sheet sets, mattress protectors at clear gift price points

categories.name: Mattresses
categories.description: Mattresses for every sleep style — memory foam, hybrid, latex, and pocket-coil. From compact-and-affordable to luxury sleep system.

categories.name: Pillows
categories.description: Match a pillow to your sleep position and preference — back, side, stomach, or combination sleepers.

categories.name: Bedding
categories.description: Sheets, duvet covers, comforters, and accent pieces. Cotton, percale, sateen, and linen weaves.

categories.name: Bed Frames
categories.description: Platform beds, adjustable bases, and storage frames. Built to last as long as your mattress.

categories.name: Accessories
categories.description: Mattress protectors, toppers, sheet sets, and sleep accessories — the layers that make a great sleep system.

products.name: Sealy Posturepedic Hybrid Plush — Queen
products.description:
The Posturepedic Plush Hybrid combines individually-wrapped pocket coils with a layer of cooling memory foam for pressure-point relief without the sink. 13-inch profile, medium-plush feel — best for back and side sleepers under 230 lbs. 10-year warranty.

  • Firmness: Medium-Plush (4/10)
  • Construction: Hybrid (pocket coil + memory foam)
  • Profile: 13 inches
  • Best for: Back & side sleepers
  • Warranty: 10 years

products.name: Tempur-Pedic ProAdapt Medium — Queen
products.description:
The ProAdapt Medium delivers Tempur-Pedic's signature precise body contouring with a balanced feel that suits most sleepers. Multiple TEMPUR® material layers absorb motion completely — your partner can move without disturbing you. 12-inch profile, 10-year warranty.

  • Firmness: Medium (5/10)
  • Construction: All-foam (TEMPUR-APR®)
  • Profile: 12 inches
  • Motion isolation: Excellent
  • Warranty: 10 years

products.name: Stearns & Foster Estate Plush Pillow Top — King
products.description:
Hand-built luxury hybrid with IntelliCoil® support and a generous pillow-top of cashmere-blend foam. The Estate Plush Pillow Top is for sleepers who prefer a soft, sink-into-the-mattress feel without losing alignment support. 16-inch profile.

  • Firmness: Plush (3/10)
  • Construction: Hybrid with cashmere pillow top
  • Profile: 16 inches
  • Best for: Side sleepers, plush-feel preference
  • Warranty: 10 years

products.name: Beautyrest Black Hybrid C-Class — Queen
products.description:
The Beautyrest Black Hybrid C-Class is built for combination sleepers who change positions through the night. T3 Pocketed Coil® technology delivers pinpoint support; charcoal-infused memory foam regulates temperature. Medium-firm balanced feel.

  • Firmness: Medium-Firm (6/10)
  • Construction: Hybrid (T3 Pocketed Coil + memory foam)
  • Profile: 14 inches
  • Cooling: Charcoal-infused foam
  • Warranty: 10 years

products.name: Endy Mattress — Queen
products.description:
Canadian-made bed-in-a-box with three layers of pressure-relieving foam. Open-cell top layer breathes well; high-density base layer holds its shape over years of use. 10-inch profile — works on any platform or slatted base.

  • Firmness: Medium (5/10)
  • Construction: All-foam (3-layer)
  • Profile: 10 inches
  • Made in: Canada
  • Trial: 100 nights

products.name: Casper Original Foam — Queen
products.description:
The original Casper, redesigned. Three-zone support targets your hips, lower back, and shoulders independently. 11-inch all-foam profile, ships compressed in a box. Best for the budget-conscious sleeper who still wants a name-brand mattress.

  • Firmness: Medium (5/10)
  • Construction: All-foam, zone support
  • Profile: 11 inches
  • Trial: 100 nights

products.name: Sealy Posturepedic Firm — Twin
products.description:
Entry-price Posturepedic with a firm, supportive feel. Reinforced edge support and targeted lumbar zone. Ideal for kids' rooms, guest rooms, or sleepers who prefer a firmer surface. 10-year warranty.

  • Firmness: Firm (7/10)
  • Construction: Innerspring
  • Profile: 10 inches
  • Size: Twin

products.name: Silk & Snow Hybrid — King
products.description:
Canadian-designed hybrid mattress with individually-wrapped coils, organic cotton cover, and a layer of natural latex. 12-inch profile balances the bounce of latex with the contouring of memory foam. 15-year warranty.

  • Firmness: Medium-Firm (6/10)
  • Construction: Hybrid (coil + latex + foam)
  • Profile: 12 inches
  • Cover: Organic cotton
  • Warranty: 15 years

products.name: Tempur-Pedic Cloud Pillow
products.description: Adaptive memory-foam pillow that conforms to your head and neck. The Cloud version is softer than Tempur's classic — best for stomach and back sleepers who want gentle support without bounce-back.

products.name: Down Alternative Hotel Pillow — Pair
products.description: Set of two down-alternative pillows with a brushed cotton cover. Hypoallergenic poly-cluster fill mimics the loft of down without the allergens. Standard or Queen size.

products.name: Cooling Gel Memory Foam Pillow
products.description: Memory-foam pillow with phase-change gel layer that wicks heat. Designed for hot sleepers and side-sleepers — the contoured shape supports neck alignment.

products.name: Premium White Down Pillow — King
products.description: Hutterite white down pillow with 700 fill power. Responsibly-sourced down, double-stitched ticking, and a 100% cotton cover. King size — the indulgent upgrade for a master bedroom.

products.name: Adjustable Bamboo Charcoal Pillow
products.description: Adjustable shredded memory foam pillow with bamboo charcoal infusion. Unzip the cover and remove fill to dial in your preferred loft. Naturally odor-resistant. Machine-washable cover.

products.name: Egyptian Cotton 600-TC Sheet Set — Queen
products.description: Long-staple Egyptian cotton, 600 thread count, sateen weave. Set includes flat sheet, fitted sheet (16-inch deep pocket), and two pillowcases. Smooth, cool, and gets softer with each wash.

products.name: Linen Duvet Cover — King
products.description: Stonewashed Belgian linen duvet cover with hidden-button closure. Breathes well in summer, layers warmly in winter. Wrinkles by design — the casual-luxury bedding standard.

products.name: All-Season Microfiber Comforter — Queen
products.description: Mid-weight microfiber comforter rated for year-round use. Box-stitched fill prevents shifting. Hypoallergenic, machine-washable, and comes in white or grey.

products.name: Percale Cotton Sheet Set — King
products.description: Crisp percale cotton with a hotel-feel finish. 400 thread count — breathable, cool, and durable. Best for hot sleepers who don't want sateen's silkier feel.

products.name: Hutterite White Down Duvet — Queen, Year-Round
products.description: Year-round weight Hutterite white down duvet with 650 fill power. Box-baffled construction prevents fill migration. Cotton sateen shell, double-stitched. Made in Canada.

products.name: Bamboo-Lyocell Sheet Set — Queen
products.description: Bamboo-lyocell blend with a silky, cool-to-touch finish. Naturally moisture-wicking and antimicrobial. Best for hot sleepers and night-sweat sufferers.

products.name: Velvet Throw Blanket — Sage
products.description: Crushed-velvet throw blanket in muted sage. Mid-weight, drapes well over the foot of the bed or a reading chair. Machine-washable.

products.name: Heated Mattress Pad — Queen
products.description: Dual-zone heated mattress pad with 10-hour timer and 20 heat settings. Each side controls independently — the answer to one partner running cold and the other running hot. Auto-shutoff and washable.

products.name: Adjustable Power Base — Queen
products.description: Wireless-remote adjustable bed base. Independent head-and-foot positioning, zero-gravity preset, USB charging ports, and under-bed lighting. Compatible with most mattresses up to 14 inches.

products.name: Upholstered Platform Bed — Queen, Charcoal
products.description: Tufted-headboard platform bed in charcoal performance fabric. Slatted base — no box spring needed. Sturdy hardwood frame, white-glove delivery available.

products.name: Storage Platform Bed — Queen, Walnut
products.description: Solid-walnut platform bed with four under-mattress storage drawers — two per side. Hidden hydraulic lift on the headboard reveals additional storage. The answer to small bedrooms.

products.name: Metal Bed Frame — Twin
products.description: Powder-coated steel bed frame for twin mattresses. No tools required for assembly. 12-inch under-bed clearance for storage bins. Best for kids' rooms, guest rooms, dorms.

products.name: Waterproof Mattress Protector — Queen
products.description: Cotton-terry top with a thin polyurethane membrane that's completely waterproof but invisibly thin — no crinkle, no plastic feel. Required to keep your mattress warranty valid.

products.name: Memory Foam Mattress Topper — Queen, 3"
products.description: 3-inch memory foam topper that softens a too-firm mattress or extends the life of a mid-life one. Gel-infused for cooling. Open-cell foam breathes well. Bamboo-blend cover, removable.

products.name: Weighted Blanket — 15 lbs, Grey
products.description: Glass-bead weighted blanket, 15 lbs. Designed for adults 130-180 lbs (~10% body weight is the recommended starting point). Removable cotton-jersey duvet cover, machine-washable.

products.name: Silk Sleep Mask
products.description: 100% mulberry silk sleep mask with adjustable elastic strap. Light-blocking, gentle on skin. Comes in a small drawstring pouch — travels well.

products.name: Sound Machine — White Noise + 16 Sounds
products.description: White-noise machine with 16 looped sounds — rain, ocean, fan, brown noise, pink noise, and more. 30/60/90-minute timers. USB-powered. The answer to noisy neighbours and city windows.
